secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs the session cookie. A development placeholder was generated so sessions survive the uvicorn --reload restarts in this sandbox; replace it with a stable value for any shared or deployed environment.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: Optional. Outbound mail server for recognition emails. Without it the app records every message in the outbox as Not sent and never claims delivery.

secrets.name: SMTP_USERNAME
secrets.description: Optional. SMTP username, if the mail server authenticates.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional. SMTP password, if the mail server authenticates.

secrets.name: SMTP_FROM
secrets.description: Optional. From address used on recognition emails.
